topic:
Boi canh: repo task-manager (D:\coding\personal-tools\task-manager), nhanh main, sach (khong co
thay doi dang do). App vua trai qua 1 dot xoa AI automation lon (CR-20260912-xoa-ai-automation-tai-cau-truc,
da merge). Nguoi dung (Leader) yeu cau tiep theo: TACH MODULE cu the (ca frontend lan phan schema DB) de
sau nay de maintenance - KHONG phai tach thanh nhieu tool/executable rieng, van la 1 app duy nhat, chi
tach code noi bo cho ro rang.

Day la PHIEN THIET KE (khong phai code-review) - can 1 KE HOACH CU THE truoc, sau do Leader (Claude Code,
khong qua Council) se tu thuc thi code truc tiep de tiet kiem token (da thong nhat cach lam nay o CR truoc).

DA CO 1 dot ra soat kien truc thuc te (agent doc code that, khong doan) - ket qua nhu sau, Council PHAI
doc ky truoc khi de xuat, khong duoc di lai tu dau:

=== KET QUA RA SOAT DA CO (dung lam diem xuat phat, khong ban lai nhung gi da xac nhan la TOT) ===

DIEM MANH (khong can sua, khong ban lai):
- Backend: 9 router tach dung theo tinh nang, dang ky ro rang o server/app.ts:40-48, khong route nao
  import cheo route khac.
- src/api.ts (lop goi API tap trung), src/context.tsx (PIC list + toast), src/ui.tsx (TimeInput/InfoTip)
  - dung la thu nen dung chung, khong man hinh nao lach fetch truc tiep.
- server/lib/recurrence.ts - vi du mau muc ve shared-lib, giu tach dung du chi con 1 noi dung.
- Khong co import vong (circular dependency) o dau ca.

VAN DE THAT CAN GIAI QUYET (co dan chung file:dong):

1. (UU TIEN CAO - FE) src/main.tsx con 2555 dong. 5 tinh nang da tach thanh file rieng
   (src/screens/project.tsx, weekly.tsx, release.tsx, src/mind-map.tsx, src/luyen-de.tsx - deu lazy-load
   tu main.tsx). NHUNG 2 tinh nang con lai CHUA tach:
   - Task ca nhan: ~1550 dong (dong 999-2555: CotTask, CotDinhKy, TaskDinhKy, 7 popup PopupSuaTask...
     PopupChiTietLichSu).
   - Quan ly PIC / Cai dat: ~565 dong (dong 431-998: ManHinhQuanLyPic, ManHinhQuanLyDanhMuc,
     ManHinhCauHinhRedmine, ManHinhQuanLyCategory).
   Ngay ca App() (dong 105-430, phan con lai) cung KHONG thuan orchestration - no chua logic nghiep vu
   Task ca nhan that: doiTrangThai (dong 210), xoaTask (218), capNhatGioDinhKy (225), thaVaoCot/batDauKeo
   (233-242, keo-tha doi trang thai task), effect thong bao trinh duyet task dinh ky (169-201).

2. (TRUNG BINH - ket noi module) server/routes/projects.ts:6,422-436 import thang 4 ham
   (mondayOf/addDays/toISODate/taskOverlapsWeek) TU server/lib/weekly-report.ts (lib rieng cua tinh nang
   Bao cao tuan, khong phai shared lib) VA tu query thang bang weekly_goals (thuoc khai niem module Weekly)
   - dung kieu "module Project choc thang vao noi bo module Weekly Report".

3. (THAP - FE common) server/lib/mappers.ts gom chung mapper cua 3 tinh nang khong lien quan
   (mapTask/mapProject.../mapReleaseTemplate...) - khong ai dung cheo nhau, chi o chung vi lich su.

4. (UU TIEN CAO - DB, theo dung yeu cau "tach ca DB" cua Leader) server/db.ts la 1 file 996 dong.
   MOT ket noi DB chung (DatabaseSync singleton, SQLite 1 file) la DUNG DAN VE KY THUAT - KHONG duoc
   de xuat tach thanh nhieu DB/connection rieng theo module (app desktop 1 nguoi dung, transaction/FK
   xuyen file se phuc tap hon loi ich). Nhung NOI DUNG file dang gom: schema CREATE TABLE cho ca 8 tinh
   nang (dong 29-387), toan bo migration lich su (390-946), va ca logic archive+xoa schema AI automation
   cu (628-725, ~100 dong logic mot-lan). Da den nguong nen tach PHAN SCHEMA (khong tach connection) theo
   tinh nang.

5. (THAP - dep dep) getRedmineBaseUrl() (server/routes/redmine.ts:48) la ham chet, khong ai goi, comment
   nhac toi hanh vi khong con ton tai.

Khong co rao chan cong cu nao (khong path alias, khong ESLint import-boundary rule) - vu #2 o tren chinh
la he qua: quy uoc thu muc mot minh khong du ngan import bua.

=== YEU CAU CU THE CHO COUNCIL (thiet ke, KHONG viet code) ===

1. THIET KE CU THE cach tach src/main.tsx:
   - File moi ten gi, chua nhung gi (chinh xac list ham/component nao chuyen sang file nao).
   - App() sau khi tach con lai gi - co that su thanh app-shell thuan (tab nav + lazy-load) khong, hay van
     con sot logic nghiep vu nao nen o lai (vd effect thong bao browser cho task dinh ky - thuoc ve tinh
     nang nao, nen o main.tsx hay chuyen theo Task ca nhan?).
   - Cac state/props phai truyen qua lai giua main.tsx va file moi tach - liet ke cu the interface
     (props) can dinh nghia, tranh vua tach xong lai phai truyen 15 props linh tinh qua lai (dau hieu
     tach sai ranh gioi).
   - Co nen tach Quan ly PIC va Cai dat (Redmine/Category) thanh 1 file hay 2 file rieng? Ca hai deu nho
     (~565 dong gop chung) - Council tu quyet dinh dua tren tinh gan bo chuc nang, khong phai chi dua vao
     so dong.

2. THIET KE CU THE cach tach schema trong server/db.ts:
   - Cau truc file moi (vd server/schema/*.ts) - moi file chua schema CUA TINH NANG NAO, ham ky signature
     ra sao (vd applySchema(db): void), thu tu goi co rang buoc FK giua cac bang khong (phai xac dinh
     bang cach doc thuc te CREATE TABLE hien tai co FK REFERENCES module khac khong, neu co thi thu tu
     tach/goi phai giu dung, khong duoc doan).
   - Phan migration lich su (390-946) va logic archive-xoa AI automation (628-725) nen xu ly the nao -
     giu nguyen 1 cho, tach theo tinh nang, hay tach theo "loai" (schema hien hanh vs migration/mot-lan)?
   - db.ts sau khi tach con lai gi - chi con mo ket noi + goi cac ham applySchema theo thu tu dung khong?

3. Danh sach thu tu THUC HIEN (khong phai chi liet ke viec, ma la trinh tu an toan - vd tach schema truoc
   hay tach FE truoc, co phu thuoc gi giua 2 viec khong).

4. Phan cong pham vi file se dung: vi day la thiet ke, Council KHONG duoc tu sua code trong phien nay -
   ket qua la 1 ke hoach chi tiet (dang tai lieu/markdown) de Claude Code tu thuc thi sau, KHONG phai
   --implement-file.

5. Neu Council thay van de #2, #3, #5 (weekly-report leak, mappers gop chung, ham chet Redmine) nen gop
   luon vao dot nay hay de rieng, hay neu ro ly do (rui ro, cong suc, co lien quan truc tiep toi #1/#4
   khong).

Yeu cau BAT BUOC: Council phai TU DOC CODE THAT (server/db.ts, src/main.tsx toan van, server/routes/projects.ts,
server/lib/weekly-report.ts, server/lib/mappers.ts) truoc khi de xuat cau truc file cu the - khong duoc
chi dua vao tom tat o tren ma doan them chi tiet.
